description: Test suite for server command functionalities in Mattermost, including server startup, systemd notification, and environment handling.

classes.name: ServerTestHelper
classes.description: Helper struct for setting up and tearing down server tests, managing signals and polling interval.

methods.name: SetupServerTest
methods.description: Initializes test environment, sets up signal channels, and adjusts polling intervals.

methods.name: TearDownServerTest
methods.description: Restores original polling interval after tests.

methods.name: TestRunServerSuccess
methods.description: Tests successful server startup with custom configuration.

methods.name: TestRunServerSystemdNotification
methods.description: Tests server startup and systemd notification via UNIX socket.

methods.name: TestRunServerNoSystemd
methods.description: Tests server startup without systemd notification environment variable.
